state.latest_email: We have been comparing a few other tools this month. Our contract renews on the 1st and honestly the export issues have cost us a lot of time. Can you send me the steps to download all our data?
open_tickets: Export to CSV times out on large projects (open 19 days)

churn_risk.instructions: How likely is the customer in state.latest_email to leave at renewal?
criteria: No sign of leaving: content, or asking routine questions
Mild friction: complains about a problem but shows no intent to leave
Looking around: mentions alternatives, renewal doubts or budget review
Preparing to leave: compares other tools and asks to export data or cancel
Leaving: says they are cancelling or will not renew
